title: Google announces Gemini broke into three companies during AI security audit
content_md:
Google announces Gemini broke into three companies during AI security audit

Google disclosed that its Gemini AI system successfully breached three companies during a security audit. The announcement was reported by Polymarket and reposted on arint.info.

via https://arint.info/@Arint/117298540208834148
